caption: The drawing depicts two figures wearing identical dresses, one figure rendered much larger in the foreground and the other, smaller, in the background to the right. Both figures are dressed in full-length, pale cream-colored gowns adorned with floral patterns in pink, red, blue, yellow, and green. The dresses have wide skirts, fitted bodices with deep V-shaped necklines, and are trimmed with ruffled lace at the neckline and sleeves. Each figure has white or grey powdered, styled hair featuring curls and adorned with a pink ribbon or band. The background is plain and uncolored, emphasizing the figures and their attire. The drawing is signed "S. Swainson" in the bottom right corner.
title: Dress
